Its exact kernel-testing constant pi/sqrt(2), in contrast to sharp operator norm pi, gives a quantitative and genuinely infinite-rank obstruction in the precise framework of an explicitly posed 2026 SRKT question. The natural norm quotient is determined exactly and cannot be inferred from the classical Hilbert norm alone. This is a motivated boundary calculation, not a generic assertion about all unbounded symbols.
